description: Copilot adoption, activity, PRs, CLI usage & AI-credit spend, incl. per-user power-user analysis. Reads the copilot_usage (+ per-IDE/feature/language/model/adoption-phase breakdown) and copilot_billing / copilot_billing_user / copilot_billing_model tables (joined with copilot_enterprise_users for emails) written to Postgres (Neon) by the collection workflow. Pick your Postgres datasource after import. NOTE: billed (net) spend is often $0 when quota covers metered (gross) usage — see the Spend detail row. Per-user panels expose emails (falling back to usernames) — restrict who can view this dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT total_active_users FROM copilot_usage ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT total_engaged_users FROM copilot_usage ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT total_engaged_users::numeric / NULLIF(total_active_users, 0) AS rate FROM copilot_usage ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT user_count FROM copilot_billing ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT total_cost_usd FROM copilot_billing ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT b.total_cost_usd / NULLIF(u.total_active_users, 0) AS cost_per_user FROM copilot_billing b JOIN copilot_usage u ON u.day = b.day ORDER BY b.day DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT model_count FROM copilot_billing ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT (SELECT total_cost_usd FROM copilot_billing ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT total_cost_usd FROM copilot_billing WHERE day = ((SELECT max(day) FROM copilot_billing) - INTERVAL '7 day')::date) AS wow_delta;

panels.title: Active vs engaged users over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", total_active_users AS "Active users", total_engaged_users AS "Engaged users" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Enterprise-wide: total daily spend divided by enterprise active users. NOT affected by the model / cost center / user filters (the active-user denominator is enterprise-grain).
panels.title: Cost per active user over time (enterprise-wide)

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.day AS "time", b.total_cost_usd / NULLIF(u.total_active_users, 0) AS "Cost per active user" FROM copilot_usage u JOIN copilot_billing b ON b.day = u.day WHERE $__timeFilter(u.day) AND u.scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY u.day;
SELECT day AS "time", total_cost_usd AS "Spend (USD)" FROM copilot_billing WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Daily spend split by model (respects the Model filter). No usernames involved.
panels.title: Spend by model

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", model_key AS metric, SUM(total_cost_usd) AS value FROM copilot_billing_model WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND model_key LIKE '$model' GROUP BY day, model_key ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Top spenders in the selected time range. Honors the Model, Cost center, User and Top N filters. Shows emails (falls back to username when no email is mapped).
panels.title: Top power users by spend

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(eu.email, bu.username_key) AS "User", MAX(COALESCE(bu.cost_center_name, '(none)')) AS "Cost center", COUNT(DISTINCT bu.model_key) AS "Models", SUM(bu.row_count) AS "Billed rows", SUM(bu.total_cost_usd) AS "Spend (USD)" FROM copilot_billing_user bu LEFT JOIN copilot_enterprise_users eu ON eu.username_key = bu.username_key AND eu.enterprise = bu.enterprise WHERE $__timeFilter(bu.day) AND bu.model_key LIKE '$model' AND COALESCE(bu.cost_center_name, '(none)') LIKE '$cost_center' AND COALESCE(eu.email, bu.username_key) LIKE '$user' GROUP BY COALESCE(eu.email, bu.username_key) ORDER BY SUM(bu.total_cost_usd) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT $top_n;

panels.description: Daily spend for the top N users (by spend over the range). Honors the Model, Cost center and User filters. Shows emails (falls back to username when no email is mapped).
panels.title: Top-N user spend over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT bu.day AS "time", COALESCE(eu.email, bu.username_key) AS metric, SUM(bu.total_cost_usd) AS value FROM copilot_billing_user bu LEFT JOIN copilot_enterprise_users eu ON eu.username_key = bu.username_key AND eu.enterprise = bu.enterprise WHERE $__timeFilter(bu.day) AND bu.model_key LIKE '$model' AND COALESCE(bu.cost_center_name, '(none)') LIKE '$cost_center' AND COALESCE(eu.email, bu.username_key) LIKE '$user' AND COALESCE(eu.email, bu.username_key) IN ( SELECT COALESCE(eu2.email, bu2.username_key) FROM copilot_billing_user bu2 LEFT JOIN copilot_enterprise_users eu2 ON eu2.username_key = bu2.username_key AND eu2.enterprise = bu2.enterprise WHERE $__timeFilter(bu2.day) AND bu2.model_key LIKE '$model' AND COALESCE(bu2.cost_center_name, '(none)') LIKE '$cost_center' AND COALESCE(eu2.email, bu2.username_key) LIKE '$user' GROUP BY COALESCE(eu2.email, bu2.username_key) ORDER BY SUM(bu2.total_cost_usd) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT $top_n ) GROUP BY bu.day, COALESCE(eu.email, bu.username_key) ORDER BY bu.day;

panels.title: Interactions & code activity over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", user_initiated_interactions AS "Interactions", code_generation_activities AS "Code generations", code_acceptance_activities AS "Code acceptances" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Enterprise-grain daily activity counts. Missing days show as gaps (no data), not zero.

panels.title: Code acceptance rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", CASE WHEN code_generation_activities > 0 THEN code_acceptance_activities::numeric / code_generation_activities END AS "Acceptance rate" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.description: code_acceptance_activities / code_generation_activities. NULL (gap) on days with no code-generation activity.

panels.title: Lines of code added vs deleted

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", loc_added AS "LOC added", loc_deleted AS "LOC deleted" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.title: Suggested vs accepted lines (added)

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", loc_suggested_added AS "LOC suggested", loc_added AS "LOC added (accepted)" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Suggested vs actually-added lines. No identities.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", pr_total_created AS "Created", pr_total_merged AS "Merged", pr_total_reviewed AS "Reviewed", pr_created_by_copilot AS "Created by Copilot", pr_reviewed_by_copilot AS "Reviewed by Copilot" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.title: Median time to merge

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", pr_median_minutes_to_merge AS "Median minutes to merge" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Median minutes from PR creation to merge (not additive; taken from the report as-is).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", cli_session_count AS "Sessions", cli_request_count AS "Requests", cli_prompt_count AS "Prompts" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.title: CLI token usage

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", cli_prompt_tokens_sum AS "Prompt tokens", cli_output_tokens_sum AS "Output tokens" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Summed CLI token usage per day.

panels.title: Code-review users (daily: active vs passive)

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", daily_active_code_review_users AS "Active reviewers", daily_passive_code_review_users AS "Passive reviewers" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Active = initiated a Copilot code review; passive = received one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", monthly_active_code_review_users AS "Monthly active", monthly_passive_code_review_users AS "Monthly passive" FROM copilot_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND scope = 'enterprise' ORDER BY day;

panels.title: Interactions by IDE

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", ide AS metric, SUM(user_initiated_interactions) AS value FROM copilot_usage_ide WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY day, ide ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Not filtered by the Model variable (usage model names differ from billing model names).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", feature AS metric, SUM(user_initiated_interactions) AS value FROM copilot_usage_feature WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY day, feature ORDER BY day;
SELECT day AS "time", language AS metric, SUM(loc_added) AS value FROM copilot_usage_language_model WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY day, language ORDER BY day;

panels.title: Engaged users by adoption phase

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", phase AS metric, SUM(total_engaged_users) AS value FROM copilot_usage_adoption_phase WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY day, phase ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Sum equals copilot_usage.total_engaged_users; absent on days with no adoption-phase data.

panels.title: Metered (gross) vs quota/discount vs billed (net)

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", gross_cost_usd AS "Metered (gross)", discount_cost_usd AS "Quota / discount", total_cost_usd AS "Billed (net)" FROM copilot_billing WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day;

panels.description: Billed (net) is often $0 because quota/discount covers the metered (gross) value. Use gross to see consumption.

panels.title: Billed as % of metered (net / gross)

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "time", CASE WHEN gross_cost_usd > 0 THEN total_cost_usd / gross_cost_usd END AS "Net / gross" FROM copilot_billing WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day;

panels.description: 0% means fully quota-covered; rises once metered usage exceeds the quota.
